Usage: protonvpn config set ipv6 [OPTIONS] {off|on}

  Enable or disable IPv6 support.

Options:
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.

  Values:
    off   Disable IPv6 (default)
    on    Enable IPv6
  
  Examples:
    protonvpn config set ipv6 on
    protonvpn config set ipv6 off
  
  Current Setting:
    Run 'protonvpn config list' to see current value.
  
  How It Works:
    When enabled, IPv6 traffic will be routed through the VPN tunnel.
